convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load PChannel_System custom indicator with buffer index 8, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position open/close logic and money management

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: BuyPosClose called when PChannel_System color component < 2 (bearish signal), SellPosClose called when color component > 2 (bullish signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. Input MM=0.1 serves as lot size when LOT mode, or as fraction in other modes.

custom_logic_notes: The PChannel_System custom indicator uses buffer index 8 which returns a 2-element array (Col[0] and Col[1]). Col[1] appears to be a color/state value where >2 = bullish, <2 = bearish, and Col[0] is a secondary condition (buy when <3, sell when >1). Entry signals are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen boolean inputs. Exit signals are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs. When SignalBar=0 the signal is recalculated every tick regardless of new bar. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen and appear to be used as expiry or timing control. The Recount flag triggers recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. LoadHistory ensures sufficient bar history before processing.
python_conversion_notes: The PChannel_System custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented since it uses iCustom with buffer 8 - the indicator's internal calculation is not visible from the EA code alone. The color-coded buffer scheme (values compared against thresholds 1, 2, 3) is non-standard and requires understanding the indicator's 9-buffer structure. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which handle the actual order placement with margin modes - these must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class and GlobalVariableDel_ function also come from this library. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points are large and likely intended for 5-digit brokers (100/200 pips equivalent) - digit adjustment logic may be inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Signal evaluation uses SignalBar=1 meaning previous completed bar, which is standard for bar-based strategies.
